title: The combinatorial receiver needs actual gadget correctness and disjoint location sets
statement: The exact integer sieve for at least t faults among L locations bounds the signed bad-gadget SUM by binom(L,t)x^t(1+x)^(L-t). Products factor for disjoint gadget location sets under the inclusive input interface. The incoming/outgoing correctable-module and all good-fault-class correctness premises must actually be supplied. The review does not handle overlapping extended rectangles or prove a norm/resource-matched universal threshold or factory. AKP common-bath/root-power Hamiltonian noise and Aharonov–Ben-Or constructions are credited as prior machinery, with their different conventions retained.
